### Opened only by keyboard or by state

- Command palette (`components/CommandPalette.tsx:116`): opened by Ctrl+K or Cmd+K only (`components/CommandPalette.tsx:47`). No visible control opens it, and it is the only way to jump straight to a loop or a calculation from any page.
- `location.state` at components/Login/Login.tsx:57: location.state?.from
- `location.hash` at App.tsx:778: location.pathname + location.search + location.hash

It shows "Not authorized" only when the user lacks `analytics.view` or is already on `/cpm`. Inside Administration each tab redirects to the first visible tab, or `/cpm` if there is none.

### Guard mismatches

- `/admin/*` (App.tsx:467) accepts ingestion.view, ingestion.manage, but the Administration menu entry (components/nav/navItems.ts:95) does not list them. A user holding only those opens the route by URL with no menu entry.
- Tab `/admin/plant-model` needs asset.view, which the `/admin/*` umbrella guard (App.tsx:467) does not list, so that permission alone is redirected before the tab loads.
- Tab `/admin/aliases` needs asset.view, which the `/admin/*` umbrella guard (App.tsx:467) does not list, so that permission alone is redirected before the tab loads.
- Tab `/admin/audit` (components/Administration/Administration.tsx:44) and its route (components/Administration/Administration.tsx:154) carry no check of their own, so any holder of one umbrella permission opens the page.
- Tab `/admin/system` (components/Administration/Administration.tsx:45) and its route (components/Administration/Administration.tsx:155) carry no check of their own, so any holder of one umbrella permission opens the page.
